blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV .
blocks.zh: 遥感场地分类是地球观测和地理空间分析中的一项基本任务. 现有方法主要遵循三个范式:任务特有视觉分类,视觉语言相似性匹配,自相递减多模式生成. 然而,视觉分级者依赖于预定义的标签空间,基于CLIP的方法通过静态图像-文本对接来进行识别,而多模式大语言模型(MLLM)引入了不必要的符号级生成,用于分类任务,并有明确的候选类别. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立遥感场景分类的一通多式决策框架RSJEV。 与常规的MLLMs将分类归为自递式文本生成不同,RSJEV将场景分类重新设定为可选条件的多式差别化决策流程,其中可视化表达,任务指令,和可选类语义共同建模. 具体地说,我们引入了“一个决定者”,它提取了多种模式的决定状态并直接估计了候选类别空间内的类别概率,消除了自旋解码,同时保持了视觉语言的互动。 对三个广泛使用的遥感场景分级基准(包括UC Merced、AID和NWPU-RESISC45)进行的广泛实验表明,与有代表性的CNN-、变形器-、曼巴-、CLIP-和基于MLLM的方法相比,RSJEV的分级性能更高。 此外,RSJEV还大幅降低了推论成本并仅用紧凑的0.8B参数模型实现了更好的精度效率取舍. 这些结果表明,有条件的多式联运决策对于高效的遥感图像了解是有效的。 该代码可在https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV上查阅。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Remote Sensing (RS) is an essential technology for Earth observation [ 1 ] , environmental monitoring [ 2 ] , disaster assessment [ 3 ] , and geospatial intelligence [ 4 ] . As a fundamental task in RS image interpretation, scene classification provides scene-level semantic information to support various geospatial applications. However, substantial intra-class variability, inter-class visual similarity, and differences in spatial resolution pose challenges to accurate RS scene classification.
blocks.zh: 遥感是地球观测[1]、环境监测[2]、灾害评估[3]和地理空间情报[4]的基本技术。 作为RS图像解释中的一项基本任务,场景分类提供了场景级语义信息来支持各种地理空间应用. 然而,阶级内部的巨大可变性,阶级之间的视觉相似性,以及空间分辨率的差异,对准确的RS场景分类提出了挑战.

blocks.en: In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) [ 5 ] and vision transformers (ViTs) [ 6 ] have substantially improved RS scene classification [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . CNNs capture local spatial patterns through hierarchical feature extraction, whereas ViTs model long-range dependencies through self-attention. These models typically use task-specific classification heads that map visual representations to a predefined label space. Although effective for supervised classification, this formulation does not explicitly incorporate candidate category semantics expressed in natural language into the prediction process. Consequently, it lacks rich semantic priors to disambiguate visually confusing categories—such as differentiating visually subtle land covers (e.g., desert versus barren land ) or geometrically akin infrastructures (e.g., railway versus freeway )—and strictly restricts the model to a fixed, non-transferable label space.
blocks.zh: 近年来,革命神经网络(CNNs)[5]和视觉变压器(ViTs)[6]大大改进了RS场景分类[7,8,9,10]. 有线电视新闻网通过分级地物提取来捕捉本地的空间模式,而ViTs模型则通过自觉来进行远程依赖. 这些模型通常使用特定任务分类头来将视觉表达图映射到预定义的标签空间. 这种表述虽然对监督分类有效,但没有明确将用自然语言表达的候选类语义纳入预测过程. 因此,它缺乏丰富的语义学前科,无法将视觉上令人困惑的类别区分开来,例如区分视觉上微妙的土地覆盖(例如沙漠与贫瘠的土地)或几何外形基础设施(例如铁路与高速公路),并将模型严格限制在一个固定的、不可转让的标签空间。

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] introduce textual category semantics into RS scene classification. CLIP [ 11 ] aligns images and natural language in a shared embedding space, enabling recognition through textual descriptions of candidate categories. CLIP-based approaches, including prompt-learning variants [ 12 , 13 ] , typically compute category scores using similarities between image and text embeddings. This formulation incorporates category semantics through embedding similarity, but provides limited direct interaction among visual features, task instructions, and candidate categories during prediction. Moreover, classification performance can depend on how category prompts are formulated.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs) [11,12,13]将文字类语义学引入RS场景分类. CLIP[11]在共享嵌入空间中将图像和自然语言相协调,通过对候选类别的文字描述得以识别. 基于CLIP的方法,包括即时学习的变体 [12,13],一般使用图像和文本嵌入的相似性来计算类别分数. 这种配方通过嵌入相似性来融合类语义,但在预测时,视觉特征,任务指令和候选类别之间的直接互动有限. 此外,分类性能取决于如何制定类别提示。

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] integrate visual representations with language modeling to support instruction-guided image interpretation. When applied to RS scene classification, generative MLLMs typically predict categories by producing textual responses autoregressively. Although this formulation supports flexible outputs, generating category names or explanatory answers can require multiple decoding steps, increasing inference latency and computational cost. For classification tasks with an explicit candidate category set, the required output is a discrete category decision, motivating prediction mechanisms that avoid iterative text generation.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs) [14,15,16,17] 将视觉表现与语言模型相融合,支持指令-引导图像解释. 在应用于RS场景分类时,基因MLLMs一般通过自动生成文本响应来预测类别. 虽然这种表述支持灵活的输出,但生成类名或解释性答案可能需要多个解码步骤,增加推论延迟和计算成本. 对于有明确候选类组的分类任务,所需产出是独立的分类决定,激发避免迭代文本生成的预测机制.

blocks.en: To retain multimodal interactions while avoiding iterative text generation, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for RS scene classification (Fig. 1 ). RSJEV reformulates classification as a candidate-conditioned discriminative decision problem, jointly modeling visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics. Specifically, we introduce OnePass Decider, which extracts the final-layer hidden state at a designated answer slot as a multimodal decision representation. It then reuses the pretrained language modeling head to score candidate options and computes category probabilities through a softmax over the candidate space. This design enables direct category prediction in a single forward pass without autoregressive answer generation.
blocks.zh: 为了保持多式互动,同时避免迭代文本生成,我们提议RSJEV,即RS场景分类的一通多式决定框架(图1)。 RSJEV将分类重新设定为候选条件的歧视性决定问题,共同模拟视觉表达,任务说明,以及候选类语义. 具体来说,我们引入了OnePass决策器,它从指定的答录槽中提取出最后一层隐藏状态作为多式决策代表. 然后再用预训语言模型头来评分候选选项,并通过对候选空间的软马克来计算类别概率. 这种设计可以在单个前传中进行直接的类别预测,而无需自动回转的答案生成.

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: • We propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for RS scene classification. It reformulates classification as a candidate-conditioned discriminative decision problem, enabling direct category prediction without autoregressive answer generation. • We introduce OnePass Decider, which extracts an answer-slot decision representation conditioned on visual content, task instructions, and candidate category semantics. It reuses the pretrained language modeling head to score candidate options and estimate probabilities within the specified candidate space. • Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets alongside comprehensive ablations demonstrate that RSJEV achieves competitive accuracy with significantly lower inference latency compared to generative MLLMs.
blocks.zh: • 本文件的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出RSJEV,即RS场景分类的一通多式决定框架。 它将分类重新定为一个有候选条件的歧视性决定问题,使直接的类别预测不产生自发的答案。 我们引入了 OnePass 决定器,它提取了一个以视觉内容,任务说明,以及候选类语义为条件的解答-片段决定表达. 它重新使用预先训练的语言模型头来评分候选选项并估计指定候选空间内的概率. • 在综合模拟的同时对三个基准数据集进行的广泛试验表明,RSJEV实现竞争性精确度,与遗传性MLLMs相比,推论延迟度要低得多。

blocks.en: We propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for RS scene classification. It reformulates classification as a candidate-conditioned discriminative decision problem, enabling direct category prediction without autoregressive answer generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出RSJEV,即RS场景分类的一通多式决定框架。 它将分类重新定为一个有候选条件的歧视性决定问题,使直接的类别预测不产生自发的答案。

blocks.en: We introduce OnePass Decider, which extracts an answer-slot decision representation conditioned on visual content, task instructions, and candidate category semantics. It reuses the pretrained language modeling head to score candidate options and estimate probabilities within the specified candidate space.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 OnePass decider,它提取了一个以视觉内容,任务说明,以及候选类语义为条件的解答-slot决定表达. 它重新使用预先训练的语言模型头来评分候选选项并估计指定候选空间内的概率.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets alongside comprehensive ablations demonstrate that RSJEV achieves competitive accuracy with significantly lower inference latency compared to generative MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 在综合模拟的同时对三个基准数据集进行的广泛试验表明,RSJEV实现竞争性精确度,与基因的MLLMs相比,推论纬度要低得多。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Conceptual comparison of different classification paradigms: (left) conventional image-only visual classifiers, (middle) similarity-based or generative MLLMs, and (right) the proposed RSJEV. By eliminating iterative autoregressive decoding, RSJEV enables instruction-guided one-pass discriminative decision-making, achieving an effective balance between classification performance and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:不同分类范式的概念比较: (左)常规图像唯可视分级器, (中)基于相似性或基因的MLLMs, (右)所拟议的RSJEV. RSJEV通过去除迭代自递解码,实现了指令制导的一通分解决策,实现分类性能和推论效率之间的有效平衡.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Remote sensing image classification has been extensively studied with the development of deep learning. CNN-based models, such as ResNet [ 7 ] , DenseNet [ 8 ] , and EfficientNet [ 18 ] , have achieved remarkable performance by learning hierarchical visual representations. Recently, Transformer-based architectures, including Vision Transformer [ 6 ] and Swin Transformer [ 19 ] , have further improved scene classification by modeling global contextual relationships. Meanwhile, emerging state-space models, such as RSMamba [ 20 ] , have explored efficient global feature modeling for remote sensing images. Despite their effectiveness, these methods generally rely on task-specific classification heads and predefined category spaces, which limits their adaptability to dynamic and open-vocabulary scenarios.
blocks.zh: 随着深入学习的发展,遥感影像分类得到了广泛的研究. 基于CNN的模型,如ResNet [7],DenseNet [8],和高效网[18],通过学习分级视觉表现,取得了显著的成绩. 最近,基于变形器的建筑,包括"视觉变形器"[6]和"斯温变形器"[19],通过模拟全球背景关系,进一步改善了场景分类. 同时,RSMamba[20]等新兴的状态-空间模型已探索了遥感图像的有效全球地物模型。 尽管这些方法很有效,但一般都依赖于特定任务分类头和预先定义的类别空格,这限制了它们的适应性,只能用于动态的和开口的情景.

blocks.en: Contrastive vision-language models incorporate textual semantics into remote sensing image recognition. CLIP [ 11 ] aligns image and text representations in a shared embedding space, enabling classification using natural-language descriptions of candidate categories. Building on this framework, RemoteCLIP [ 21 ] expands remote sensing pretraining data by converting detection and segmentation annotations into image-caption pairs. SkyScript [ 22 ] constructs remote sensing image-text pairs using semantic information from OpenStreetMap and supports continual pretraining of SkyCLIP. These efforts improve image-text alignment for the remote sensing domain. In their standard zero-shot classification setting, category predictions are obtained by comparing image embeddings with text embeddings of candidate categories. This similarity-based formulation differs from constructing a joint decision representation conditioned on image content, task instructions, and the candidate set.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的视觉语言模型将文字语义纳入遥感图像识别. CLIP[11]在共享嵌入空间中将图像和文字表达相协调,从而能够使用候选人类别的自然语言描述进行分类. 在这个框架的基础上,ReptectCLIP[21]通过将探测和分解说明转换为图像封装对来扩展遥感预训数据. SkyScript [22] 利用OpenStreetMap的语义信息构建了遥感图像-文本对并支持SkyCLIP的持续预训. 这些努力改进了遥感领域的图像文本协调。 在其标准零发分类设置中,通过将图像嵌入与候选类别的文本嵌入进行比较,获得类别预测. 这种基于相似性的表述方式不同于构建以图像内容、任务说明和候选人组合为条件的联合决策表述方式。

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models combine visual encoders with language models to support image-conditioned language tasks. General models, including BLIP-2 [ 23 ] , LLaVA [ 24 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 14 ] , and InternVL3 [ 15 ] , provide a foundation for multimodal image interpretation. In remote sensing, GeoChat [ 17 ] supports image- and region-level conversations and visual grounding. LHRS-Bot [ 25 ] leverages volunteered geographic information to construct training data and introduces a multi-level vision-language alignment strategy. EarthGPT [ 26 ] integrates interpretation tasks across optical, synthetic aperture radar, and infrared imagery through multisensor instruction tuning. These models primarily formulate task outputs as autoregressively generated responses. For scene classification with explicit candidate categories, generating category names or explanatory answers can require additional decoding steps. RSJEV instead extracts a candidate-conditioned decision representation at an answer slot and directly scores candidate options, enabling classification without iterative answer generation.
blocks.zh: 多模式大语言模型将视觉编码器和语言模型结合起来,以支持图像条件化的语言任务. 一般型号,包括BLIP-2 [23],LLAVA [24],Quen3-VL [14],和InternVL3 [15],为多式图像解释打下基础. 在遥感方面,GeoChat [17] 支持图像级和地区级的对话和视觉地面. LHRS-Bot [25] 利用自愿提供的地理信息来构建培训数据,并推出多层次的愿景语言协调战略。 EarthGPT [26]通过多传感器指令调谐,将光学,合成孔径雷达,红外线图像的解说任务整合. 这些模式主要提出任务产出,作为自动生成的响应。 对于带有明确候选类别的场景分类,生成类名或解释性答案可能需要额外的解码步骤. RSJEV反而在答题时抽取一个有候选人条件的决定代表并直接给候选人选项打分,从而可以不迭代答生成进行分类.

blocks.en: The reviewed methods primarily focus on visual representation learning, contrastive image-text alignment, or generative multimodal interpretation. RSJEV adopts a candidate-conditioned discriminative formulation that extracts an answer-slot representation from the multimodal backbone and reuses the pretrained language modeling head to score candidate options. By conditioning the decision representation on image content, task instructions, and candidate category semantics, RSJEV directly estimates category probabilities in a single forward pass without iterative text generation.
blocks.zh: 所审查的方法主要侧重于视觉表现学习、对比性图像文本相接,或遗传性多式联运解释。 RSJEV采用了一种具有候选条件的歧视性配方,从多模式主干线中提取出一个解析槽,再利用预先训练的语言模型头来评分候选选项. 通过对图像内容,任务指令,以及候选类语义等内容进行决定表示的限定,RSJEV直接在一次没有迭代文本生成的单个前传中估计类别概率.

blocks.en: III-B RSJEV
blocks.zh: 三-B 雷克谢夫

blocks.en: In the original JEV [ 27 ] , the same question needs to be expanded into multiple input paths according to the number of candidate options, and each path is separately fed into the model. For remote sensing image classification, this process requires repeated computation of image features and textual task prompts, introducing additional computational overhead. To address this issue, we propose RSJEV, which completes task decision through a single forward pass with one input path. The details are introduced as follows:
blocks.zh: 在最初的JEV [27]中,同样的问题需要根据候选选项的数量被扩展为多条输入路径,每个路径被单独输入到模型中. 就遥感图像分类而言,这一过程需要反复计算图像特征和文字任务提示,引入额外的计算起落架. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议通过一个输入路径的单一前进通道完成任务决定。 详细情况如下:

blocks.en: III-B 1 Overall Workflow
blocks.zh: 总体工作流量

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , RSJEV combines a pretrained multimodal backbone with OnePass Decider (OPD) for one-pass scene classification. The backbone jointly processes the image and a task prompt containing the instruction and candidate categories. OPD extracts the final-layer hidden state at the classification answer slot and reuses the pretrained language modeling head to compute candidate-option scores. Softmax converts these scores into category probabilities, and the highest-scoring option determines the prediction without autoregressive answer generation.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,RSJEV将预先训练的多式主干线与OnePass Consultter(OPD)结合,用于一通场景分类. 骨干部分联合处理图像和包含指令和候选类别的任务提示. OPD在分类解答槽中取出最终层隐藏状态并再用预训语言模型头来计算候选选项分数. Softmax将这些分数转换为类别概率,最高得分的选项决定了预测,而无需自动回转的答案生成.

blocks.en: III-B 2 Model Components
blocks.zh: 三-B 2 模型组件

blocks.en: MLLM Backbone: We adopt pretrained multimodal large language models as the multimodal backbone of RSJEV. The backbone jointly processes the remote sensing image and the task prompt containing the classification instruction and candidate category descriptions, producing contextualized multimodal hidden states. OPD then uses the final-layer hidden state at the classification answer slot for discriminative prediction.
blocks.zh: MLLM 语言语言 后骨: 我们采用经过预先培训的多式大型语言模型作为RSJEV的多式主干. 骨干部分联合处理遥感图像和包含分类指示和候选类别描述的任务提示,产生上下文的多模式隐藏状态。 OPD然后在分类解答槽中使用最终层隐藏状态来进行歧视性预测.

blocks.en: OnePass Decider: To exploit multimodal contextual representations for direct classification while avoiding autoregressive decoding overhead, we introduce OPD for candidate-conditioned discriminative decision-making. OPD uses the final-layer hidden state at the designated [RSSC] answer slot to directly estimate candidate category probabilities within a single forward pass, without iterative answer-token generation. This representation is conditioned on the image, task instruction, and candidate category descriptions.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate RSJEV on three remote sensing scene classification benchmarks: UCM, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45. After describing the datasets and implementation details, we compare its classification performance with representative baselines. We then assess the applicability of OPD across different MLLM backbones. Finally, we compare RSJEV with generative MLLM baselines in terms of inference latency, GPU memory consumption, and throughput.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价RSJEV的三个遥感场景分类基准:UCM、AID和NWPU-RESISC45。 在描述数据集和执行细节后,我们将其分类业绩同有代表性的基线进行比较。 然后,我们评估业务发展办公室在不同劳动、劳动和劳工部主干网中的适用性。 最后,我们将RSJEV与基因MLLM基线在推论纬度,GPU内存消耗和吞吐量方面进行比较.

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset Description
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集说明

blocks.en: We evaluate RSJEV on three widely used remote sensing scene classification datasets: UC Merced Land Use (UCM) [ 28 ] , Aerial Image Dataset (AID) [ 29 ] , and NWPU-RESISC45 (NWPU) [ 30 ] . Following the split protocol in [ 9 ] , we adopt the UCM-55, AID-28, and NWPU-28 settings, which use 50%, 20%, and 20% of the images for training, respectively, with the remaining images used for testing.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个广泛使用的遥感场景分类数据集上评价RSJEV:UC Merced Land use (UCM) [28], Air Image Data set (AID) [29],和NWPU-RESISC45 (NSPU) [30]. 在[9]中分出协议后,我们采用UCM-55,AID-28,和NWPU-28设置,分别使用50%,20%和20%的图像进行训练,其余的图像用于测试.

blocks.en:
UCM [ 28 ] :
The dataset contains 2,100 aerial images spanning 21 scene categories, with 100 images per category. The images have a spatial resolution of approximately 0.3 m per pixel and are typically 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels in size.
blocks.zh:

数据集包含2 100个空中图像,涵盖21个场景类别,每个场景类别有100个图像。 图像的空间分辨率约为每像素0.3米,大小一般为256×256相256相256相.

AID [ 29 ] :
The dataset comprises 10,000 aerial images collected from Google Earth, covering 30 scene categories with 220–420 images per category. Each image is 600 × 600 600\times 600 pixels in size, with spatial resolutions ranging from 0.5 to 8 m per pixel.

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: TABLE I: Comparison with state-of-the-art methods on three remote sensing scene classification benchmarks. The bold and underlined values denote the best and second-best results, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:与三个遥感场地分级基准的先进方法相比较. 大胆和强调的价值观分别表明最佳和次好的结果。

blocks.en: Experimental Settings: The experiments are conducted based on the Qwen3.5-0.8B [ 14 ] multimodal model. During training, the model is optimized using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 0.01, and a learning rate warm-up strategy with 50 warm-up steps. Following existing JEV-style implementations 1 1 1 https://github.com/Mapika/decider , we use cross-entropy loss together with Brier score regularization during training. The model is trained for 10 epochs on eight NVIDIA RTX A40 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 16, resulting in a total batch size of 128. The input image resolution is dynamically adjusted by the multimodal backbone, with the maximum token length is limited to 1536. Random image flipping is applied during training to improve the generalization ability of the model. The label smoothing coefficient is set to 0.05. All experiments are conducted using FP32 precision.
blocks.zh: 实验 设置 : 实验是在Quen3.5-0.8B[14]多式联运模型的基础上进行的。 在训练期间,该模型被优化使用AdamW优化器,学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}体重衰减为0.01,学习取暖策略有50个取暖步骤. 在现有的JEV风格实施之后, 该型号在8个NVIDIA RTX A40 GPU上为10个纪元进行训练,每GPU批量尺寸为16个,因此总批量尺寸为128个. 输入图像分辨率由多模式主干线动态调整,最大符号长度限制为1536. 随机图像翻转在训练中被应用来提高模型的通化能力. 标签平滑系数被设定为0.05. 所有实验都使用FP32精度进行.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics: We use precision (P), recall (R), F1-score (F1), and overall accuracy (OA) as evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 评价计量: 我们使用精确度(P)、回顾度(R)、F1-分数(F1)和总体精确度(OA)作为评价指标。

blocks.en: IV-C Comparison Experiments
blocks.zh: 四-C 比较实验

blocks.en: We compare RSJEV with representative approaches from five categories: CNN-based Classification Models, Transformer-based Classification Models, Mamba-based Classification Models, Vision-Language Models, and Multimodal Large Language Models. Specifically, the CNN-based baselines include ResNet-101 [ 7 ] , DenseNet-161 [ 8 ] , and EfficientNet [ 18 ] . The Transformer-based baselines include DeiT III [ 31 ] , Swin Transformer [ 19 ] , and Vision Transformer [ 6 ] . The Mamba-based baselines include VMamba [ 32 ] , Vision Mamba [ 33 ] , and RSMamba [ 20 ] . The Vision-Language Models include Open-CLIP [ 11 ] , MaPLe [ 12 ] , and OSCLIP [ 13 ] . The Multimodal Large Language Models include Qwen3-VL [ 14 ] , InternVL3 [ 15 ] , LHRS-Bot-Nova [ 16 ] , and GeoChat [ 17 ] . For CNN-, Transformer-, and Mamba-based models, we initialize the networks with ImageNet-1K pretrained weights provided by MMPreTrain [ 34 ] . For Vision-Language Models and Multimodal Large Language Models, we use their officially released pretrained checkpoints and further fine-tune them on the remote sensing scene classification task.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了RSJEV与五个类别的代表性方法:基于CNN的分类模型、基于变形器的分类模型、基于曼巴的分类模型、愿景语言模型和多模式大语言模型。 具体来说,基于CNN的基线包括ResNet-101 [7],DenseNet-161 [8],以及高效网 [18]. 基于变形器的基线包括DeiT III [31],Swin变形器 [19],和Vision变形器. [6]. 基于曼巴的基线包括:VMamba[32]、Vision Mamba[33]和RSMamba[20]。 视觉-语言模型包括Open-CLIP [11],MaPLe [12],和OSCLIP [13]. 多式联运大型语言模型包括:Qune3-VL [14],InternVL3 [15],LHRS-Bot-Nova [16],和GeoChat [17]. 对于CNN-,变形器-,和曼巴-的模型,我们用MMPreTrain提供的ImageNet-1K预训重量来初始化网络[34]. 对于Visual-Langage Models和多模式大型语言模型,我们使用它们正式发布的预先训练的检查站,并在遥感场景分类任务上进一步细化.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Quantitative Analyses
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 定量分析

blocks.en: As reported in Table I , RSJEV achieves the highest precision, recall, F1-score, and overall accuracy across all three benchmarks. Specifically, its F1-scores reach 97.72%, 96.30%, and 94.58% on UCM, AID, and NWPU, respectively. Compared with the best-performing existing method on each dataset: namely OSCLIP on UCM, Qwen3-VL on AID, and VMamba on NWPU, RSJEV achieves improvements of 0.39, 0.78, and 0.41 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, RSJEV consistently outperforms all evaluated contrastive vision-language models and generative MLLMs. Crucially, these gains are attained with a compact 0.8B-parameter backbone, outperforming scaled generative counterparts spanning 2B to 8B parameters. These empirical comparisons firmly demonstrate that RSJEV delivers superior classification performance while maintaining remarkable parameter efficiency.
blocks.zh: 如表一所报告,RSJEV在所有三个基准中都实现了最高精度、回顾、F1-分数和总体精度。 具体来说,其F1分数在UCM、AID和NWPU分别达到97.72%、96.30%和94.58%。 与每个数据集上表现最好的现有方法相比:即UCM上的OSCLIP,AID上的Quen3-VL和NWPU上的VMamba,RSJEV分别实现0.39,0.78和0.41个百分点的改进. 此外,RSJEV的业绩始终高于所有被评价的具有对比性的视觉语言模型和遗传性的MLLMs。 关键的是,这些成果是通过0.8B参数的紧凑骨干实现的,其业绩超过了2B至8B参数的分基因对应物。 这些经验性比较坚定地表明,RSJEV在保持显著参数效率的同时,能提供优异的分类性能.

blocks.en: IV-D Generalizability of OnePass Decider
blocks.zh: 四-D 统一决策人的通用性

blocks.en: We evaluate the effectiveness and generalizability of OPD across different MLLM backbones, with detailed results reported in Table II . Baseline denotes the generative classification configuration of each backbone, i.e., standard autoregressive next-token prediction of category answers, whereas Ours denotes the corresponding model equipped with OPD. On Qwen3.5-0.8B, OPD improves precision from 87.96%, 91.29%, and 88.24% to 97.80%, 96.44%, and 94.61% on UCM, AID, and NWPU, respectively, corresponding to gains of 9.84, 5.15, and 6.37 percentage points. To further assess whether these improvements generalize beyond the backbone used in the main experiments, we additionally adapt OPD to InternVL3.5-1B. OPD again consistently improves precision across all three benchmarks, yielding gains of 3.47, 4.01, and 1.39 percentage points on UCM, AID, and NWPU, respectively. These consistent improvements across both Qwen3.5-0.8B and InternVL3.5-1B demonstrate that OPD is not tied to a specific MLLM backbone and exhibits strong generalizability across different architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们评价业务发展办公室在不同劳动、劳工和劳工部骨干部门的效力和普遍性,详细结果见表二。 基线表示每个主干线的基因分级配置,即标准自旋接下个接吻的类别答案预测,而Ours表示配备OPD的相应模型. 在Quen3.5-0.8B上,OPD的精度分别由87.96%,91.29%和88.24%提高到97.80%,96.44%,在UCM,AID和NWPU上分别达到94.61%,分别相当于9.84,5.15和6.37个百分点的增益. 为了进一步评估这些改进是否超越了主要实验中使用的骨干,我们又将OPD改用InternVL3.5-1B. 业务发展办公室还不断提高所有三项基准的精确度,在铀转化厂、国际开发部和核武股分别提高了3.47、4.01和1.39个百分点。 这些贯穿于Quen3.5-0.8B和InternVL3.5-1B的一致改进表明,OPD没有与特定的MLLM主干网挂钩,并显示出不同架构的强烈通俗性.

blocks.en: IV-E Inference Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-E 推断效率分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the inference efficiency of RSJEV against six MLLM baselines: Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3-VL-2B, InternVL3.5-1B, InternVL3-2B, LHRS-Bot-Nova-8B, and GeoChat-7B. All measurements are conducted on a single NVIDIA A40 GPU in bfloat16 precision with a batch size of 1, using 30 test images after a five-image warm-up. GPU memory consumption and inference latency are reported in Fig. 4 , while throughput is presented in Fig. 4 . RSJEV achieves the lowest GPU memory consumption and inference latency among the evaluated methods, requiring 1.68 GB of GPU memory and 102.18 ms per image. Its throughput reaches 9.79 FPS, exceeding all generative baselines, whose throughput ranges from 1.31 to 4.09 FPS. Specifically, RSJEV achieves 4.31 times the throughput of Qwen3.5 and 2.39 times that of InternVL3, the fastest generative baseline. These results highlight the efficiency of the compact RSJEV model, which directly estimates candidate category probabilities through a single forward pass without autoregressive answer generation. Together with the classification results in Table I , these findings demonstrate that RSJEV combines strong classification performance with lower memory requirements and faster inference than the evaluated MLLM baselines, offering a favorable performance-efficiency balance for remote sensing scene classification.
blocks.zh: 我们对照六个MLLM基线评估RSJEV的推论效率:Qun3.5-0.8B,Qun3-VL-2B,InternVL3.5-1B,InternVL3-2B,LHRS-Bot-Nova-8B和GeoChat-7B. 所有测量均用单个NVIDIA A40 GPU在bfloat16精度上进行,批量尺寸为1,在五相热后使用30个测试图像. GPU内存消耗和推论性在图4中被报告,而吞吐量在图中被显示. 4,RSJEV在被评价的方法中实现了最低的GPU内存消耗和推论延迟,需要1.68GB的GPU内存和102.18ms的每个图像. 其吞吐量达到9.79FPS,超过了所有基因基线,其吞吐量从1.31到4.09FPS. 具体而言,RSJEV的吞吐量是Quen3.5和InternVL3的2.39的4.31倍,这是最快的基因基线。 这些结果凸显出紧凑的RSJEV模型的效率,该模型直接通过一个没有自相递回的答案生成的单个前传来估计候选类别概率. 与表一中的分类结果一起,这些调查结果表明RSJEV结合了强大的分类性能和较低的内存要求,以及比所评价的MLLM基线更快的推论,为遥感场地分类提供了有利的性能-效率平衡.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. RSJEV reformulates classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision problem by jointly modeling visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics. The proposed OnePass Decider directly estimates candidate category probabilities from the final-layer hidden state at the classification answer slot, avoiding the additional decoding overhead of autoregressive answer generation. Experiments demonstrate that RSJEV achieves strong classification performance while substantially improving inference efficiency over generative MLLM baselines. Cross-backbone experiments further validate the effectiveness and generalizability of OnePass Decider across different MLLM architectures. Consequently, RSJEV highlights the considerable potential of JEV-style multimodal discriminative modeling as a new decision paradigm for remote sensing, offering a promising direction toward more efficient and scalable multimodal foundation models.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了RSJEV这一遥感场景分类的一通多式决策框架。 RSJEV通过联合建模视觉表现,任务说明,以及候选类语义,将分类重新确定为具有候选条件的多式歧视决定问题. 提议的OnePass决策员直接估算分类解答槽中最终层隐藏状态的候选类别概率,避免了自递回式解答生成的额外解码间接费用. 实验表明RSJEV实现了强大的分类性能,同时大大地提高了比基因MLLM基线的推论效率. 交叉后骨实验进一步验证了OnePass决策器在不同MLLM架构中的有效性和通性. 因此,RSJEV强调了JEV式的多式差别模型作为遥感新决策范式的巨大潜力,为更有效和可扩展的多式基础模型提供了有希望的方向。
